test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements is true?

A) Money Supply is a stock concept

B) Currency and Coins with public are not included in M3 measure of money supply
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only A.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Money Supply:-**

 
 
• It is a stock concept, which means it represents the total amount of money available in an economy at a specific point in time.
 
• M3 measure of money supply includes all forms of money, including currency and coins with public, but excludes time deposits with maturity period more than 2 years.
 
• Money Supply is a stock concept. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Currency and coins with public:-**

 
 
• These are included in M1 measure of money supply, which includes all physical currency and coins, demand deposits, and other checkable deposits.
 
 
 
• **M2:-**
 
 
• It measure of money supply includes M1 plus savings deposits, money market securities, and time deposits with maturity period less than 2 years.
 
 
 
• **Money Supply:-**
 
 
• It is a key indicator of the state of an economy and is closely monitored by central banks to regulate inflation and economic growth.
